description: Dadex Eternit Limited, incorporated in 1959, manufactures and sells construction materials, principally piping systems and allied products made from chrysotile cement, rubber and plastics, along with imported pipe fittings and building products. Its range covers polyethylene, polypropylene random and uPVC pipe systems, chrysotile cement pressure and sewer pipes, roofing, and architectural cladding and curtain wall.
headOffice: Dadex House, 34-A/1, Block 6, P.E.C.H.S., Shahrah-e-Faisal, Karachi-75400
